verdict.rationale: Navan's developer docs mention an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow for API access (navan-docs-2), which implies some credential-based authentication, but there is no explicit documentation of scoped permissions, granular access levels, or least-privilege controls specifically for AI agents connecting via MCP or API. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission definitions, least-privilege role configuration, agent-specific credential restrictions, and any documentation or independent verification of access-control granularity.
